title: Write integration tests for bidirectional message flow
description: Write integration tests demonstrating bidirectional message flow between LICHEN and IRC. Tests should cover: LICHEN message appears in mapped IRC channel with correct provenance; IRC message reaches LICHEN recipient through native messaging; unauthorized IRC users are rejected; rate limits and queue bounds are enforced; duplicates are suppressed across reconnect; store-and-forward works across simulated outages; malformed content and oversized messages are rejected. Use the simulator with at least two LICHEN nodes and a mock IRC server. Document test scenarios and expected behavior.
